headline: DraftKings turns profitable as sportsbook margins strengthen
summary_short: DraftKings swung to a $21.1M net income ($0.03 diluted EPS) in the quarter versus a $33.9M net loss a year ago, as revenue grew 16.8% y/y to $1.65B on Sportsbook Net Revenue Margin improving to 7.8% from 6.4%.
summary_long: Sportsbook revenue rose 24.1% as Net Revenue Margin improved to 7.8% from 6.4% on higher hold and better promotional reinvestment; iGaming grew 8.9%, partly offset by a 13.0% decline in Fantasy/Lottery revenue following the Texas Lottery exit. Cost of revenue fell to 57.7% of revenue from 59.9% on scale economies, driving operating income to $5.8M from a $46.3M loss. Net income reached $21.1M, aided by a $22.8M gain on contingent-consideration revaluation. Cash fell to $999.4M from $1,127.5M q/q on $98.6M of Stock Repurchase Program buybacks and $24.3M of RSU-withholding purchases, partly offset by narrower operating cash use ($48.4M vs $119.0M a year ago). No numeric forward guidance appears in this filing.

drivers.explanation: Management ties its path to consolidated profitability to accelerating contribution-profit growth from efficient customer acquisition, strong retention, and scale benefits as jurisdictions mature.
